pages.text: A fast Iron-tier weapon, traded for reach shorter than a sword's. Each Villager killed with it permanently adds 1.25% damage to that dagger, up to 50% after 40 kills.$(br2)Villager Soul drops are twice as likely when the killing blow comes from the dagger. It cannot receive Unbreaking or Mending.
pages.title: Ominous Dagger
Obtaining
pages.text: The dagger comes out of the $(l:raidborn:mechanics/transmutation_table)Transmutation Table$(/l). Each one keeps its own kill count, so a replacement starts over at zero.
